require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'fileutils'
require 'open3'
o = File.expand_path(__dir__)
prior = File.expand_path('../scalar-first-candidate-2026-10-30', o)
acceptance = JSON.parse(File.read(prior + '/acceptance-receipt.json'))
raise 'Prior candidate not accepted' unless acceptance['status'] == 'accepted'
sha = ->(p) { Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest }
acceptance.fetch('evidence_hashes').each { |p, h| raise 'Prior evidence drift' unless sha.call(prior + '/' + p) == h }
bin = prior + '/candidate-kujo'
probe = prior + '/task-allocation-probe'
out = o + '/report.json'
raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(out)
shapes = {
  'scalar-array-pair' => ['state[0] = amount state[1] = [amount]', ['VALUE', '[VALUE]', '0']],
  'array-scalar-pair' => ['state[1] = [amount] state[0] = amount', ['VALUE', '[VALUE]', '0']],
  'string-first' => ['state[0] = "entry" state[1] = amount state[2] = amount', ['"entry"', 'VALUE', 'VALUE']],
  'string-last' => ['state[1] = amount state[2] = amount state[0] = "entry"', ['"entry"', 'VALUE', 'VALUE']],
  'arithmetic-index' => ['state[offset + 0] = amount state[offset + 1] = [amount] state[offset + 2] = {"value": amount}', ['VALUE', '[VALUE]', '{"value": VALUE}']],
  'literal-index' => ['state[0] = amount state[1] = [amount] state[2] = {"value": amount}', ['VALUE', '[VALUE]', '{"value": VALUE}']]
}
r = {status: 'running', pid: Process.pid, identities: [bin, probe, __FILE__].to_h { |p| [p, sha.call(p)] }, sources: {}, rows: [], semantics: []}
save = -> { File.write(out, JSON.pretty_generate(r) + "\n") }
save.call
begin
  shapes.keys.product([8, 2048], %w[once fresh], [1, 2, 16, 32]).each do |shape, width, snapshot, calls|
    writes, expected = shapes.fetch(shape)
    d = o + '/fixtures/' + [shape, width, snapshot, calls].join('-')
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(d)
    check = ->(name, amount) { expected.each_with_index.map { |value, index| "assert_equal(#{name}[#{index}], #{value.gsub('VALUE', amount.to_s)})" }.join(' ') }
    owner = "mut state := [] mut k := 0 while k < #{width} { state = push(state, 0) k += 1 }\nexport func snapshot() { return state }\nexport func edit(amount, offset) { #{writes} return amount }\n"
    before = snapshot == 'fresh' ? 'let saved := snapshot()' : ''
    after = snapshot == 'fresh' ? 'if i == 0 { assert_equal(saved[0], 0) assert_equal(saved[1], 0) assert_equal(saved[2], 0) } else { ' + check.call('saved', 'i') + ' }' : ''
    source = "from owner import snapshot, edit\nlet original := snapshot()\nmut i := 0 while i < #{calls} { #{before} assert_equal(edit(i + 1, 0), i + 1) #{after} i += 1 }\nlet final := snapshot() #{check.call('final', calls)} assert_equal(len(final), #{width}) mut k := 0 while k < #{width} { assert_equal(original[k], 0) if k >= 3 { assert_equal(final[k], 0) } k += 1 } print(\"ARRAY SHAPE PASS\")\n"
    File.write(d + '/owner.kujo', owner)
    File.write(d + '/main.kujo', source)
    [d + '/owner.kujo', d + '/main.kujo'].each { |p| r[:sources][p] = sha.call(p) }
    meta = {shape: shape, width: width, snapshot: snapshot, calls: calls, path: d + '/main.kujo'}
    %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
      args = [probe, mode, meta[:path]]
      stdout, stderr, status = Open3.capture3(*args)
      m = stderr.match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
      raise stdout + stderr unless status.success? && stdout == "ARRAY SHAPE PASS\n" && m
      r[:rows] << meta.merge(mode: mode, argv: args, stdout: stdout, stderr: stderr, exit: status.exitstatus, requests: m[1].to_i, bytes: m[2].to_i)
      save.call
    end
    %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
      args = [bin, 'run', meta[:path], '--untrusted', '--scheduler-no-timeout'] + (mode == 'vm' ? [] : ['--' + mode])
      stdout, stderr, status = Open3.capture3(*args)
      raise stdout + stderr unless status.success? && stdout == "ARRAY SHAPE PASS\n"
      r[:semantics] << meta.merge(mode: mode, argv: args, stdout: stdout, stderr: stderr, exit: status.exitstatus)
      save.call
    end
  end
  raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size == 192 && r[:semantics].size == 288
  r[:slopes] = r[:rows].group_by { |x| x.values_at(:shape, :width, :snapshot, :mode) }.map do |key, rows|
    a, b = rows.sort_by { |x| x[:calls] }.last(2)
    {group: key, bytes: (b[:bytes] - a[:bytes]) / 16.0, requests: (b[:requests] - a[:requests]) / 16.0}
  end
  r[:identities].merge(r[:sources]).each { |p, h| raise 'Artifact/source drift' unless sha.call(p) == h }
  r[:status] = 'characterized'
  save.call
rescue => e
  r[:status] = 'failed'
  r[:error] = e.message
  save.call
  raise
end

require 'json'
require 'digest'
o = File.expand_path(__dir__)
sha = ->(p) { Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest }
r = JSON.parse(File.read(o + '/report.json'))
raise 'Incomplete report' unless r['status'] == 'characterized'
r.fetch('identities').merge(r.fetch('sources')).each { |p, h| raise 'Identity drift ' + p unless sha.call(p) == h }
prior = File.expand_path('../scalar-first-candidate-2026-10-30', o)
shapes = %w[scalar-array-pair array-scalar-pair string-first string-last arithmetic-index literal-index]
cases = shapes.product([8, 2048], %w[once fresh], [1, 2, 16, 32])
expected_sources = cases.flat_map { |c| %w[main.kujo owner.kujo].map { |f| o + '/fixtures/' + c.join('-') + '/' + f } }.sort
raise 'Source coverage' unless r['sources'].keys.sort == expected_sources
%w[rows semantics].each do |kind|
  modes = kind == 'rows' ? %w[vm jit] : %w[vm interpreter jit]
  expected = cases.flat_map { |c| modes.map { |m| c + [m] } }
  raise 'Exact case coverage' unless r[kind].map { |x| x.values_at('shape', 'width', 'snapshot', 'calls', 'mode') }.sort == expected.sort
  r[kind].each do |row|
    path = o + '/fixtures/' + row.values_at('shape', 'width', 'snapshot', 'calls').join('-') + '/main.kujo'
    mode = row['mode']
    argv = kind == 'rows' ? [prior + '/task-allocation-probe', mode, path] : [prior + '/candidate-kujo', 'run', path, '--untrusted', '--scheduler-no-timeout'] + (mode == 'vm' ? [] : ['--' + mode])
    raise 'Invocation/result mismatch' unless row['path'] == path && row['argv'] == argv && row['exit'] == 0 && row['stdout'] == "ARRAY SHAPE PASS\n"
    if kind == 'rows'
      raw = row['stderr'].scan(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
      raise 'Raw counters' unless raw == [[row['requests'].to_s, row['bytes'].to_s]]
    end
  end
end
slopes = r['rows'].group_by { |x| x.values_at('shape', 'width', 'snapshot', 'mode') }.map do |group, rows|
  a, b = rows.sort_by { |x| x['calls'] }.last(2)
  {'group' => group, 'bytes' => (b['bytes'] - a['bytes']) / 16.0, 'requests' => (b['requests'] - a['requests']) / 16.0}
end
raise 'Slope mismatch' unless slopes == r['slopes']
penalties = shapes.product(%w[once fresh], %w[vm jit]).map do |shape, snapshot, mode|
  small, wide = [8, 2048].map { |width| slopes.find { |x| x['group'] == [shape, width, snapshot, mode] } }
  {group: [shape, snapshot, mode], small_bytes: small['bytes'], wide_bytes: wide['bytes'], width_penalty: wide['bytes'] - small['bytes']}
end
File.write(o + '/verified.json', JSON.pretty_generate({status: 'verified', allocation_observations: 192, semantic_checks: 288, width_penalties: penalties, report_sha256: sha.call(o + '/report.json'), verifier_sha256: sha.call(__FILE__), limits: 'Characterization only. Fresh-snapshot costs can be required by value semantics; no elapsed-speed inference.'}) + "\n")
puts 'Array-shape matrix and raw evidence verified'
